from PIL import Image
import os

base = '/Users/huage/Obsidian Vault/写作知识库/01-资源库/2026-04-02/牛油果神仙吃法'

# --- 封面图：裁剪为 900×383 \(2.35:1\) ---
cover = Image.open\(f'{base}/06-封面图/cover.png'\)
w, h = cover.size  # 2048×2048
# 从中心裁切 2.35:1
target_w, target_h = 900, 383
ratio = target_w / target_h
if w/h > ratio:
    new_w = int\(h * ratio\)
    offset = \(w - new_w\) // 2
    cover = cover.crop\(\(offset, 0, offset + new_w, h\)\)
else:
    new_h = int\(w / ratio\)
    offset = \(h - new_h\) // 2
    cover = cover.crop\(\(0, offset, w, offset + new_h\)\)
cover = cover.resize\(\(target_w, target_h\), Image.LANCZOS\)
cover.save\(f'{base}/06-封面图/cover.png', 'PNG', optimize=True\)
print\(f'封面: {cover.size}'\)

# --- 配图：裁剪为 608×810 \(3:4\) ---
img_names = ['img-01','img-02','img-03','img-04','img-05','img-06']
target_w, target_h = 608, 810
for name in img_names:
    path = f'{base}/07-配图/{name}.png'
    img = Image.open\(path\)
    w, h = img.size  # 2048×2048
    ratio = target_w / target_h
    if w/h > ratio:
        new_w = int\(h * ratio\)
        offset = \(w - new_w\) // 2
        img = img.crop\(\(offset, 0, offset + new_w, h\)\)
    else:
        new_h = int\(w / ratio\)
        offset = \(h - new_h\) // 2
        img = img.crop\(\(0, offset, w, offset + new_h\)\)
    img = img.resize\(\(target_w, target_h\), Image.LANCZOS\)
    img.save\(path, 'PNG', optimize=True\)
    print\(f'{name}: {img.size}'\)
